# Every test the persistence-backed irctest job (ci.yml, irctest-services)
# skips, as the JUnit report names it, under the reason it skips.
# check_skips.py fails the job on a skip missing here and on an entry here
# that no longer skips. A new entry needs its reason.

# e6ircd does not offer draft/event-playback: CHATHISTORY replays messages,
# not JOIN/PART/TAGMSG events.
irctest.server_tests.chathistory.ChathistoryTestCase::testChathistoryEventPlayback[AFTER]
irctest.server_tests.chathistory.ChathistoryTestCase::testChathistoryEventPlayback[AROUND]
irctest.server_tests.chathistory.ChathistoryTestCase::testChathistoryEventPlayback[BEFORE]
irctest.server_tests.chathistory.ChathistoryTestCase::testChathistoryEventPlayback[BETWEEN]
irctest.server_tests.chathistory.ChathistoryTestCase::testChathistoryEventPlayback[LATEST]
irctest.server_tests.chathistory.ChathistoryTestCase::testChathistoryTagmsg

# An authenticated session cannot replace its identity with a second SASL
# exchange (907 ERR_SASLALREADY).
irctest.server_tests.sasl.SaslTestCase::testPlainPostRegistrationAndReAuthenticate
irctest.server_tests.sasl.SaslTestCase::testPlainReAuthenticate

# The server offers PLAIN and OAUTHBEARER; SCRAM is on the client side only.
irctest.server_tests.sasl.SaslTestCase::testScramSha256Failure
irctest.server_tests.sasl.SaslTestCase::testScramSha256Success

# irctest itself marks these skipped ("Not consistently implemented").
irctest.server_tests.who.WhoTestCase::testWhoRealNameSpaces
irctest.server_tests.who.WhoTestCase::testWhoUsernameRealName[hostname]
irctest.server_tests.who.WhoTestCase::testWhoUsernameRealName[realname-mask]
irctest.server_tests.who.WhoTestCase::testWhoUsernameRealName[username]
